entities.name: Siren Sea
entities.description: The vast ocean bordering the western coast of Theros, home of the tritons and ruled by Thassa.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane whose western coast the sea borders.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The sea god who rules the Siren Sea.

entities.name: Tritons
entities.description: Devoted guardians of Thassa who dwell within the sea.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The sun god who destroyed Olantin with his spear.

entities.name: Olantin
entities.description: A prosperous coastal polis destroyed by Heliod's wrath.

entities.name: Triarchy
entities.description: Priesthood of Heliod at Olantin that conjured a false sun.

entities.name: Arixmethes
entities.description: A slumbering kraken mistaken for an island.

entities.name: Callaphe
entities.description: A hero who found sanctuary on Ketaphos.

entities.name: Skathos
entities.description: A cursed island once a site of Pharikan rites, now a place of stone and silence.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: God of horizons with a shrine at the Temple of Mystery.

entities.name: Queen Korinna
entities.description: Her death caused Thassa's tears to form the Dakra Isles.

entities.name: Dakra Isles
entities.description: Magical islands that emerged where Thassa's tears fell.

events.summary: Heliod destroys Olantin with a spear thrown from Nyx after the Triarchy conjures a false sun.
events.quote: Heliod hurled his spear down from Nyx, destroying Olantin in a single stroke.

events.summary: The Triarchy conjures an immense orb of light to mimic the absent sun.
events.quote: the Triarchy conjured an immense orb of light to mimic the absent sun

events.summary: Arixmethes awakens, destroying the city built on its back.
events.quote: When Arixmethes awakened, the city was destroyed

events.summary: The Dakra Isles emerge where Thassa's tears fell after Queen Korinna's death.
events.quote: these magical islands emerged where Thassa's tears fell after the death of Queen Korinna
